array.string: exec >"$HOME/Library/Logs/i9-tunnel.log" 2>&1; for port in {3000..3099} {54321..54324} 54331 54341 54351 54361 54371; do forwards+=(-L "$port:127.0.0.1:$port"); done; tunnel=(/usr/bin/ssh -N -l i9-tunnel -i "$HOME/.ssh/i9-tunnel" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o IdentityAgent=none -o BatchMode=yes -o HostKeyAlias=i9 -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 "${forwards[@]}"); cable() { /usr/bin/nc -z -G 1 10.42.0.2 22 2>/dev/null; }; cable && exec "${tunnel[@]}" -p 22 10.42.0.2; "${tunnel[@]}" -p 2222 i9 & ssh=$!; { until cable; do sleep 10; done; kill $ssh; } & wait $ssh
